implementationTheme: deterministic foliage morphology diversity and formal evidence binding
problem: The generated fallback trees already had connected woody geometry, three explicit two-sided leaf-spray meshes, thin-dielectric foliage optics and LODs. However, three exact spray topologies repeated across at least 24 source leaf clusters per tree, creating a native-4K risk that neighboring foliage would read as stamped/cloned cards even when material shading was physically plausible.

sourceAudit.existingLeafMeshConstruction: BuildLeafSprayMesh emits each explicit two-sided leaf as a contiguous eight-vertex group (front/back duplicated for coherent normals/tangents).
sourceAudit.clusterCountDerivation: Seven primary branches x two secondary branches x two twigs/leaf clusters = 28 source LeafCluster ordinals per generated tree.
sourceAudit.existingVariation: The original tree generator varied cluster transform scale and cycled only GM_LeafSpray_A/B/C. Foliage optics varied dark/mid material and exposure/transmission, but exact geometry topology still repeated frequently.
sourceAudit.risk: At 3840x2160, repeated silhouette/card topology can trigger obvious_repetition and reduce vegetation natural-complexity credibility; a morphology swap between retained LOD proxies can additionally create visible_lod_pop or temporal shimmer.

implementation.assignment: Stable integer mapping from tree index + LeafCluster ordinal to 12 morphology assets; no runtime randomness. Consecutive ordinals traverse all twelve variants because multiplier 7 is coprime to 12.
implementation.lodIdentity: Every source and retained proxy renderer carrying the same parsed LeafCluster ordinal is assigned the exact same morphology mesh asset.
implementation.buildChain: QualityBlockFoliageOpticsUpgrade now applies morphology immediately after QualityBlockTreeDetailUpgrade and before thin-leaf optical material/property-block application. QualityBlockGroundDetailUpgrade already calls BuildFoliageOptics in the normal quality chain.
implementation.formalGuard: QualityBlockFoliageMorphologyDiversityQA is InitializeOnLoad and re-validates the machine-readable contract plus current morphology state on 3840x2160 QA4K_/QAPreparedTemporal_ pre-cull.
implementation.lookdev: Assets/QA/lookdev/foliage_morphology_diversity_lookdev.svg documents clone risk, 12-variant intent, LOD identity and required rendered review; explicitly not render evidence.

verification.compareAgainstStart: 5 commits ahead / 0 behind before this run-record commit; merge-base remained startHead; changed files were exclusively under UnityProject/.
verification.assignmentArithmeticChecked: For ordinals 0..27 on tree indices 0..5, the deterministic mapping produces all 12 variants with maximum exact use 3 per tree.
verification.sourceTopologyChecked: Existing BuildLeafSprayMesh source confirms eight vertices per two-sided lamina, matching the derivation algorithm's grouping assumption.

expectedFutureImpact.vegetationNaturalComplexity: Direct positive source-side potential by reducing exact leaf-spray clone recognition.
expectedFutureImpact.textureMicrodetail: Indirect positive potential because repeated silhouette/card topology no longer reinforces repeated texture perception as strongly.
expectedFutureImpact.temporalLodAliasing: Positive source-side potential because retained LeafCluster ordinals keep exact morphology identity across LODs.
expectedFutureImpact.cinematicImage: Secondary positive potential through more natural crown breakup at hero/oblique framing.

sequence: Run normal build chain and confirm twelve GM_LeafSpray_Morph_00..11 assets are generated.
Run morphology formal-state QA and verify each generated tree has all twelve source variants with max exact use <=3 in the current 28-cluster construction.
Confirm retained LOD proxies preserve exact morphology identity by LeafCluster ordinal.
Produce sealed 3840x2160 hero, oblique and grazing stills plus required 100% crops.
Review oblique/vegetation_grounding and grazing/tree_shadow_contact for clone recognition, floating clusters, plastic/metallic flash and crown silhouette.
Review temporal/subpixel_grazing for leaf-edge shimmer and morphology/BRDF LOD discontinuity.
Only then score Vegetation, Texture/Microdetail and Temporal/LOD from actual rendered evidence.
